titulo_original: Al son que me toquen bailo

sinopsis.es: Brian, un joven futbolista, debe decidir entre perseguir sus sueños o permanecer junto a la comunidad que lo vio crecer. En una noche que cambiará su vida para siempre, enfrentará una decisión que pondrá a prueba su identidad, sus afectos y su futuro.
sinopsis.en: Brian, a young footballer, must decide between chasing his dreams or staying with the community that raised him. In a night that will change his life forever, he faces a decision that will test his identity, his bonds and his future.
